itens.trecho: Uma teoria demasiado famosa para ser um mistério. Este filme é sobre um ex-pastor evangélico que perdeu a fé, mas que será testado quando o seu campo de milho é parcialmente esmagado, criando um círculo de colheitas.

Is it really about aliens? M. Night Shyamalan's "Signs" (2002) is about a disillusioned ex-minister (Mel Gibson) who lives in the country with his son & daughter and brother (Juaquin Phoenix). The reasons for his disillusionment become clear as the story unfolds.

It's barely over an hour and a half this film, but it seems much longer. Mel Gibson ("Graham") is a widowed former pastor who lives on a farm with his two kids "Morgan" (Rory Culkin) and "Bo" (Abigail Breslin) and his brother "Merrill" (Joaquin Phoenix).
